Login.title: Sign in
Login.subtitle: Enter your credentials to access the dashboard.

Dashboard.title: GPRS Dashboard
Dashboard.description: Consolidated view across all pharmacies — sales, purchase, stock, and finance.

sales.emptyText: No sales data — import a Sales Register file first.

purchase.emptyText: No purchase data — import a Purchase Register file first.

finance.emptyText: No gross profit data — import Sales and Stock files first.

stock.emptyText: No stock data — import a Stock Register file first.

sales.title: Sales Report
sales.description: Party/item-wise sales detail, one row per line item — same shape as Purchase and Stock, not aggregated.
sales.emptyText: No sales data — import a Sales Register file first.

stock.title: Stock Report
stock.description: Current stock by batch, across branches.
stock.emptyText: No stock data — import a Stock Register file first.

purchase.title: Purchase Report
purchase.description: Item-wise purchase detail, including the scheme % implied by free quantity received on each line.
purchase.emptyText: No purchase data — import a Purchase Register file first.

daySales.title: Day-Wise Sales
daySales.description: Daily bill totals exactly as reported by Marg's Day-Wise Sale export. Independent of the Stock/Purchase/Sales import pipeline — never summed with those reports.
daySales.emptyText: No Day-Wise Sale data — import a Day-Wise Sale file first.

Import.title: Import Data
Import.description: Upload the daily Excel exports from Marg, one calendar day at a time: Stock, then Purchase, then Sales, in that order. Day-Wise Sale is independent and can be uploaded any time.
Import.branchPlaceholder: Select the branch to import against
Import.selectBranchDescription: Choose the branch above to start importing files against it.
Import.noImportsYet: No {title} imports yet for this branch
Import.getStarted: Upload Stock to get started for this branch.
Import.cycleComplete: {date} is fully imported — ready for the next date's Stock.
Import.cyclePending: Stock done for {date} — now upload {pending} for that date.

stockRegister.title: Stock Register
stockRegister.description: Item-wise current stock, batches, expiry, cost/sale price — must be for a single day.

purchaseRegister.title: Purchase Register
purchaseRegister.description: Supplier/item-wise purchases — must be for a single day, and Stock must already be uploaded for that date.

salesRegister.title: Sales Register
salesRegister.description: Party/item-wise sales — must be for a single day, and Stock must already be uploaded for that date.

dayWiseSale.title: Day-Wise Sale (Sales Book)
dayWiseSale.description: Daily bill totals — independent of the pipeline above, can span any date range.

Import.bulkUploadSubtitle: Select several Stock/Purchase/Sales/Day-Wise Sale files at once — each file's type is detected automatically. Every file must still be for a single day.
Import.bulkUploadDropzoneTitle: Drag files here, or click to browse
Import.bulkUploadDropzoneHint: .xls or .xlsx — any mix of Stock, Purchase, Sales, Day-Wise Sale
Import.bulkUploadAllAccepted: All {count} file(s) accepted — processing in the background
Import.bulkUploadSomeRejected: {accepted} file(s) accepted, {rejected} rejected — see details below

Branches.title: Branches
Branches.description: Register pharmacy branches. Each branch's contact person also becomes its login user.
Branches.emptyText: No branches yet — register one to start importing data.
Branches.deleteDescription: This also removes the branch's login account. Blocked if the branch already has imports on record.
Branches.registerSubtitle: The contact person below also becomes this branch's login user, with the standard default password.
Branches.branchRegistered: Branch registered — the contact person can log in with the default account password
